test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

P. fish, or other potential food item that happen

Q. to be floating by with stinging cells called nematocysts

R. at night and capture tiny organisms like zooplankton, small

S. corals are predators and they extend their tentacles
solution:
The correct arrangement of the sentence is indeed: **SRPQ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

 
• The correct answer is **option 4) SRPQ **because it follows the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• It starts by introducing the subject and their action** ("Corals are predators and they extend their tentacles").**
 
• Then, it provides the timing and method of their feeding ("at night and capture tiny organisms like zooplankton, small fish, or other potential food items").
 
• Finally, it describes the nature of these floating food items and the presence of stinging cells ("that happen to be floating by with stinging cells called nematocysts").
 
• This order ensures the sentence is coherent and conveys the intended meaning.

 

**The correct order of the sentence parts is as follows:**

**S.** Corals are predators and they extend their tentacles

**R.** at night and capture tiny organisms like zooplankton, small

**P.** fish, or other potential food item that happen

**Q. **to be floating by with stinging cells called nematocysts
